digest.title: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
digest.tldr: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.

digest.title: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
digest.tldr: NVIDIA’s Ian Buck kicked off the company’s week at SC26 in Chicago on Monday with new tools for AI agents, software that can plan experiments, run code and check results on researchers’ own systems.

digest.title: Nvidia’s first big move after Jensen Huang’s exit targets national security
digest.tldr: The new standing committee will give board-level oversight of national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risks, the company said.
